Subject: Re: Request: Temporary P1/P2 response rota & formal exception for FintechCo

Hi Markus,

Quick note — over the last two weeks we had two P1 incidents where our incident responders waited more than 6 hours for an initial acknowledgement. Our SLA with Redwood (P1: 2 hours, P2: 8 hours) is blocking our compliance review and the security team is escalating.

We need a short-term operational fix while we work through the contractual amendment. Specifically: can Redwood provide a temporary on-call rota with guaranteed P1/P2 response windows for the next 30 days, and a formal exception letter that we can file with our auditors? Procurement gave us PR-3492 and asked for the exception in writing.

Happy to jump on a quick call today if useful.

Thanks,
Alex Porter

Alex — thanks for flagging and I'm sorry you hit delays. I appreciate the PR number.

Short answer: we can put a temporary operational commitment in place while legal drafts a formal rider. Proposed interim commitments (operational, not contractual):
- P1: initial acknowledgement within 4 hours, action plan within 6 hours (24/7)
- P2: initial acknowledgement within 8 hours (business hours Mon-Fri)
- Coverage window: 2026-06-15 through 2026-07-15 (30 days)

I've asked Marissa (CS lead) to share a proposed on-call rota and the P1 runbook. If you can confirm acceptance of the interim windows above, we'll produce a one-page exception letter for your records and route a contract rider to Legal.

Proposed attachment: proposed_oncall_rota.xlsx (spreadsheet) — sent by CS.

If this works, please confirm and we'll finalize the wording today.

—Markus

Alex — we've reviewed and I can approve a temporary operational exception for FintechCo for the dates 2026-06-15 through 2026-07-15. Summary of the approval and expectations: 

- Approved interim response windows (operational, non-contractual): P1 ack <= 4 hours (24/7); P1 action plan <= 6 hours; P2 ack <= 8 hours (Mon-Fri business hours).
- Escalation path (operational): 1) Redwood-CS primary on-call (ack) -> 2) Escalation Triager (senior CS) -> 3) EngOps via pager (if required). All incidents must be logged in the DevSupport portal with incident ID and timestamps.
- Reporting: weekly incident summary (Mon) to FintechCo ops and a post-mortem for any P1.
- Documentation: we'll deliver a one-page exception letter (signed by Redwood VP Support) and a shared folder with the P1 runbook excerpts.

Commercial note: Sean / Neha, please log the exception against deal FT-8421 and confirm whether any credit or SLA rebate applies under the current contract; include PR-3492 in the paperwork.

I'll attach the formal exception draft after Legal OK. For now, consider this operational approval.

Rachel Kim
VP, Support & Operations, Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.com
